Which statement about ionic compounds is correct?
A
Giant lattices are formed when ionic compounds crystallise from solution.
B
In all ionic compounds, the metal ions have fewer electrons than the non-metal ions.
C
In a giant lattice, ions of the same charge are closer together than ions of opposite charge.
D
When ionic compounds melt, strong intermolecular forces are broken.

options.label: A
options.text: Giant lattices are formed when ionic compounds crystallise from solution.

options.label: B
options.text: In all ionic compounds, the metal ions have fewer electrons than the non-metal ions.

options.label: C
options.text: In a giant lattice, ions of the same charge are closer together than ions of opposite charge.

options.label: D
options.text: When ionic compounds melt, strong intermolecular forces are broken.
